title: Collectables - Pint-Sized Slasher Masks Guide

sections.title: Finding Them
sections.html:
{finding_sentence}

  • Listen for them. When you get close to a mask you hear a laughing sound.
    You can turn it up in Settings › Audio › Effects.
  • One per character. Once you pick one up, it won't respawn for that character.
  • Only while the event is on. {quest} is only available for the duration of The Slasher Seasonal Content.
  • They're yours only. Masks can't be dropped, traded or sold.
  • Track the challenge. Go to Menu › Challenges › Appalachia › (Seasonal) Collect Pint-Sized Slasher Masks and press Track.
  • Where they go. Masks go in the Misc tab of your Pip-Boy as {item_name}.

sections.title: How to Start {quest}
sections.html:
Option 1 – Listen to the "Breaking News" radio broadcast on your Pip-Boy radio

{quest} pops up on its own when you log in while The Slasher Seasonal Event is on, with the objective Listen to the "Breaking News" radio broadcast. You can only listen to it once: after that the broadcast is gone from your radio. You get a copy you can play again with your first mask (see Step 1 below).

{img:start-breaking-news-radio}

sections.title: {quest} Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Find the masks

After the broadcast, the objective is Find Pint-Sized Slasher Masks in cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds. You need {quest_masks} for the quest. There's no one to hand them in to: the quest counts them as you pick them up. With your first mask you also get the holotape Broadcast Recording: Breaking News, a copy of the broadcast you can play as often as you like.

{img:walkthrough-broadcast-holotape}

Step 2 – Collect the clippings

Some masks have a newspaper clipping inside. They pop up on their own as you go, so there's nothing extra to find: see Collecting the Masks below for which mask gives which.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/article-clipping-1-note.avif}

Step 3 – Read the torn page

Your {quest_masks_th} mask gives you A page torn from a children's book. Read it: it's a children's poem about the Pint-Sized Slasher, with directions written underneath.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/a-page-torn-from-a-children-s-book-note.avif}

Step 4 – Follow the directions

The objective is now Investigate the area described in the note, with the hint "By the dog kennel, he smells your fear". What you find there is in The Finale below (spoilers). Optional: the quest also asks you to tune in to The Debunker radio station for more news reports.

sections.title: Collecting the Masks
sections.html:
There’s no one to hand the masks in to: the quest counts them as you pick them up, in {batch_count} batches, totalling {quest_masks} of the {total} available.

The lifetime challenges keep counting after that.

{batch_table}

Full rewards list and tracker: The Slasher Guide

extra.q: Can I do this after The Slasher ends?
extra.a: No. {quest} is only available for the duration of The Slasher Seasonal Content.

sections.title: The Finale
sections.html:
The directions under the poem read "Amid the ruins of suburbia, by road 85. Look for him." Head there and search the dog kennel the quest marks.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/we-re-coming-for-you-location.avif}

By the kennel the killers have left a bloody mess, and in it the note We're Coming For You. Pick it up and {quest} is done.

{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/collectables/Slasher-Masks/Slasher-Lore/we-re-coming-for-you-note.avif}

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
The Breaking News broadcast comes from Remington Goodwin of The Debunker news radio station. He reports corpses displayed all over Appalachia, and a violent group paying homage to the serial killer known as the Pint-Sized Slasher.

The note at the kennel is signed by the Pint-Sized Phantoms, who say they bargain with death on his behalf, and promise more "gifts".

Every broadcast, clipping and note from this quest, with the full text: The Slasher Lore Checklist.
